approval.checkpoint_0: approved to pin by the project owner on 2026-11-10

decisions.1: Option A: prefix-history features only; Option B (request-time protocol) deferred to separate research
decisions.10: Fixed 9 features; subsets P,S,H,P+S,P+S+H; C {0.01,0.1,1,10}; alpha 0.0..1.0 step 0.1; selection on tuning validation by equal-weight macro NDCG@1
decisions.11: Gate support: >=50 per class per fold valid, 30-49 exploratory (not RQ3), <30 refused; ties counted separately; no silent changes of folds, regularization, target or features
decisions.12: Primary hybrid chosen on tuning validation and frozen; static and gated both reported on final; only the pre-chosen one used for main claims
decisions.13: Initializations are not extra dataset seeds; their variance is never merged into bootstrap or across-seed intervals
decisions.14: Gated iff all tuning gates valid and Delta_val > 0 (equal-weight macro NDCG@1 over 6 groups after all selections); otherwise static; not evidence for RQ3
decisions.15: Final gates: >=50 valid (confirmatory), 30-49 exploratory (descriptive only), <30 rejected (not trained, not used, 'not evaluable under the preregistered protocol'); no fallback to static after final evaluation; details in final_gate_rules
decisions.2: Oracle router (evaluator within/cross label) as a separately reported diagnostic upper bound only; never selected or claimed
decisions.3: Gate trained on customer-level 3-fold OOF SASRec scores from the train split; no in-sample SASRec scores
decisions.4: Non-inferiority margin 0.01 NDCG@1, fixed before any Phase 3.1 dataset exists
decisions.5: Three SASRec initialization seeds {1,2,3}; per-case mean over initializations per dataset seed, then across-seed analysis; initialization variance reported separately
decisions.6: 7-day window secondary; no window-specific tuning of alpha or gate
decisions.7: P_PF Laplace-smoothed counts, P_SASRec softmax; no fitted score normalizers, no temperature scaling, no smoothing tuning; identical deterministic candidate sets
decisions.8: Soft-label gate target 1/0.5/0 (SASRec NDCG@1 >, =, < PF); L2 BCE with fractional targets; proxy limitation stated
decisions.9: No per-profile parameters and no profile/seed/dataset features; alpha and gate per task

documentation_notes: Initialization seeds {1,2,3} are model seeds; seed 1 equalling the Phase 3 training seed does not reuse any Phase 3 dataset. Dataset seeds and initialization seeds are kept separate.
Round-robin fold assignment is deterministic and uses whole customers as the split unit; label-distribution validity is checked separately through the support thresholds.

criteria.RQ1: lower bound of (primary hybrid - PF) > -0.01 in each of habit/NBS, habit/NBP, balanced/NBS, balanced/NBP
criteria.RQ2: transition/NBS: (primary hybrid - PF) interval > 0 and lower bound of (primary hybrid - SASRec Full) > -0.01
criteria.RQ3: macro-average over six groups of (gated - static) interval > 0; confirmatory only if every final gate is valid, else 'not satisfiable per protocol'
criteria.gated_primary_with_invalid_final_gate: cell not confirmatory; group's RQ1/RQ2 reported not evaluable per protocol; no fallback

interpretation.RQ1 only: safe for habit/balanced, sequential value not shown
interpretation.no fusion beats PF: no case for a hybrid as main model

statistics.within_seed: paired customer-level bootstrap on per-case initialization means, n_boot=1000

features.history_sessions: delimited by history-only boundary flags; earliest represented step never a boundary
features.standardization: fitted on train-split OOF features of the dataset, applied unchanged to val/test

RQ1_RQ2: if validation chose static fusion, gate invalidity does not block evaluating the static primary hybrid
if validation chose gated fusion, exploratory or rejected final cells cannot support confirmatory gated-hybrid claims
RQ1/RQ2 for affected groups are 'not evaluable under the preregistered protocol'
no fallback from gated to static for any group after final evaluation
RQ3: RQ3 can be declared met only if every final cell needed for the six-group macro-average has a valid gate
if one or more such cells are exploratory or rejected, RQ3 is 'not evaluable under the preregistered protocol'
results of valid cells may be reported descriptively, but invalid cells are never dropped from the confirmatory macro-average
a gate is never replaced by static fusion to resolve insufficient support

exploratory.treatment: may be reported descriptively; never counted as confirmatory evidence

rejected.treatment: gate not trained and not used; reported as 'not evaluable under the preregistered protocol'

forbidden_inputs: target timestamp or any difference to it
target session id or target-derived boundary
events at or after the recommendation time
behavior profile, seed, or dataset/generator identity

cross_fitting.assignment: sort tokens, permute with numpy default_rng(3101), round-robin

gate.objective: sum BCE(y, sigmoid(w.x+b)) + ||w||^2/(2C), bias unregularized, fractional targets
reported: counts y=0/0.5/1 per fold, task, initialization, dataset
alpha(x) distribution on val/test: mean, SD, P5, P50, P95

support.count_classes: y=0 and y=1 only; y=0.5 counted separately

target.basis: NDCG@1 on train-split cases with OOF SASRec scores

label: SYNTHETIC-DATA EXPERIMENT: metrics reflect patterns deliberately embedded by the synthetic generator. They are not evidence of real customer behavior or of real-world recommendation effectiveness.

gated_fusion.weights: refitted per dataset on its train split

models.oracle_router: SASRec on evaluator within-session cases, PF on cross-session cases; diagnostic only
models.personal_frequency: Phase 2.3 grid (signal), selected per dataset on validation
models.sasrec_full: Phase 3 frozen configuration 46fa3eca387ed2bf8e1a5e12cacb652084022cb4acf0c2fb8ae0a65d9b133d59; no SASRec HPO

normalization.candidate_sets: identical across PF/SASRec/static/gated, sorted item ids

notes: Phase 3.1 pre-registration, written before any Phase 3.1 seed or dataset exists. Any change requires a new pre-registration; this manifest is never edited.
reporting_rules: never replace unavailable values with zero
never silently drop a group from a macro-average
report the number of valid cells and the denominator used
distinguish the statuses valid, exploratory and not evaluable
never conclude a model failed on performance when its result is not evaluable because of insufficient support

research_questions.RQ1: non-inferiority of the primary hybrid vs PF in habit/NBS, habit/NBP, balanced/NBS, balanced/NBP
research_questions.RQ2: transition/NBS: primary hybrid superior to PF and non-inferior to SASRec Full
research_questions.RQ4: cost: training incl. OOF, inference latency, peak GPU memory, parameters

seed_policy.collision_check: against every registered seed including all Phase 3 seeds
seed_policy.reserve_after: this pre-registration is pinned and verified (later checkpoint)

selection.delta_val: (1/6) * sum_g (NDCG@1_gated,g - NDCG@1_static,g); group value = mean over its tuning datasets; computed after all selections
selection.objective: equal-weight macro-average NDCG@1 over the six (profile, task) groups on tuning validation
selection.primary_hybrid_rule: gated iff every tuning dataset x task x initialization gate is valid and Delta_val > 0; else static

status_labels.not_evaluable: not evaluable under the preregistered protocol
